detailed_description:
The target video is a living painterly illustration in <Subject 1>: brushstroke texture stays visible as everything moves, motion is slow, gentle and dreamlike.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. Inside the round dew drop the tiny reflected starry sky glimmers, its golden point pulsing softly. The camera pulls back and rises at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move. The drop shrinks in the frame and the wide green lily pad around it comes into view, covered with smaller dew drops that sparkle like stars. A white water lily beside the pad slowly opens its petals in the warm sunrise. The shimmering deep teal water appears around the pad, reflecting the pale gold sky where the last stars fade one by one. Soft mist drifts low over the pond and gentle ripples spread from the edge of the pad. The camera is still pulling gently back as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
